in_arabic.name: غفور
in_arabic.long_meaning: غفور هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، مشتق من الجذر غفر، والغفران يعني التكفير عن الذنب، والغفور هو الذي يغفر الذنوب ويستر العيوب، وهو اسم يظهر في القرآن الكريم في nhiều آیات، ويُعتبر من الأسماء المهمة في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: غفور
in_urdu.long_meaning: غفور اللہ تعالیٰ کے صفات میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے گناہوں کو معاف کرنے والا، یہ نام قرآن پاک میں بھی ذکر کیا گیا ہے، اور اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہمیت کے حامل ہے، یہ نام 南 ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت популяр ہے

in_hindi.name: ग़फ़ूर
in_hindi.long_meaning: ग़फ़ूर एक ऐसा नाम है जो अल्लाह की सिफ़तों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है पापों को क्षमा करने वाला, यह नाम कुरआन में भी उल्लेखित है, और भारतीय मुसलमानों में बहुत महत्व रखता है, यह नाम पवित्रता और दया का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: غفور
in_pashto.long_meaning: غفور د الله تعالیٰ د صفتونو څخه دی، چې د ګناهونو د بخښنې په معنا دی، دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر شوی دی، او د افغان/پښتنو دود İz میں ډیر اهمیت لري، دا نوم د پښتنو په کلتور کې د بخښنې او میهنی د پاله په توګه ګڼل کیږي

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ghafoor" in Islamic culture carries a deep meaning and showcases the essential qualities of forgiveness and mercy, which are highly valued traits in the Muslim community. This name signifies Allah's ability to forgive and overlook human errors and transgressions. It serves as a reminder that even when we make mistakes, our creator is capable of granting us forgiveness and granting us a fresh start.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Ghafoor" highlights the manifestation of Allah's divine mercy and compassion towards His creation. It serves as a reminder of the infinite love and mercy that Allah holds for us, despite our shortcomings and mistakes. This name helps to instill a sense of inner peace and tranquility, knowing that no mistake or transgression is too great for the Gateway of Forgiveness to not be open. Ultimately, "Ghafoor" is a testament to the boundless compassion and mercy of Allah, who is constantly ready to forgive and forgive again.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Al-Ghafur is one of the 99 Beautiful Names of Allah in Islam, and it is often translated as 'The Forgiving'. This name is mentioned in the Quran multiple times, for instance in Surah Al-Fatiha, the opening chapter of the Quran, where Allah is addressed as Al-Ghaffar or Al-Ghafur.

The name Al-Ghafur is also mentioned in various Hadiths, or sayings of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). For example, in one Hadith, the Prophet (pbuh) said: 'The most beloved things with Allah are prayer done in the early hours and forbearance (ghafur) in anger'.
